svg.title: behemoth1415 — the behemoth, weight-2: one SG-level gate W_c ^= W_a | !W_b as six fan-in ≤ 2 gadgets
svg.desc: The replicated per-gate body: exactly 1415 gates, deterministically (291+288+291+291+127+127 for G1..G6 = r57/nab/and/and/copy/copy). Same construction as behemoth939 with every fan-in ≥ 3 gate mask-first decomposed (gate_gadget_w2); mp* = persistent mask-prefix cache shared across sub-gadgets (per-sub-gadget mask classification via set_masks), restored by flush(). Encoding/decoding is fixed infrastructure, not shown.
svg.text: behemoth1415 — the behemoth, weight-2: one SG-level gate W_c ^= W_a | !W_b as six fan-in ≤ 2 gadgets
The replicated per-gate body: exactly 1415 gates, deterministically (291+288+291+291+127+127 for G1..G6 = r57/nab/and/and/copy/copy). Same construction
as behemoth939 with every fan-in ≥ 3 gate mask-first decomposed (gate_gadget_w2); mp* = persistent mask-prefix cache shared across sub-gadgets
(per-sub-gadget mask classification via set_masks), restored by flush(). Encoding/decoding is fixed infrastructure, not shown.
W_c' = W_c ⊕ (W_a ∨ ¬W_b); every sub-gadget ends with the 0-gate re-share relabeling
